reviews.review:
The Anacrusis follows a well known concept: a Left 4 Dead style coop shooter where you advance through levels, with safe rooms in between, tons of enemies, different enemy classes and many weapons and items. 
At first glance it sounds fun, but playing it feels like the devs just threw random pieces together and hoped it would work.

The animations are basic, the graphics are basic (20 years ago they might have been okay, I guess), and the game suffers from more or less annoying bugs here and there. Teammates floating in the air or standing on the sides of walls, enemies getting stuck on objects or in doorways…

Voice acting is flat and boring, guns feel weak (probably because they sound weak), and the environments are mostly empty, lifeless, or ugly. Rocks in particular look terrible and there’s almost no environmental destruction besides breaking a bit of glass.

Wayfinding can be confusing, 

The music feels all over the place as well. One second it’s funky 70s stuff, then techno, then RTS ambient tracks, then horror game music. It makes the whole game feel like it has no theme.

I played only about 2.4 hours, but I was already bored enough to just uninstall the game. 
And honestly, considering the game came out in 2023, I really don’t understand why it looks so ugly and dated.

With a different engine (from this century?), music that actually follows a consistent theme, a few bug fixes, more attention to environment design and detail, and voice actors who speak more than robotic one liners and don’t sound like they’re about to fall asleep, this could have been a really cool game.

Not like this, tho.

[h2] Overall, The Anacrusis has a fun concept and some potential, but sloppy execution, outdated visuals, inconsistent music, and annoying bugs make it hard to enjoy. With more polish, more love to detail, it could have been a great coop game, but right now it’s just disappointing and not worth buying. [/h2]
